# AGPAL

> AGPAL is Australia's leading not-for-profit general practice accreditation body, providing comprehensive accreditation services against RACGP Standards for diverse healthcare settings.

Established in 1997 and governed by seven member organisations, AGPAL accredits general practices, Aboriginal Medical Services, rural and remote clinics, corporate groups, and after-hours services across Australia using the AccreditationPro platform. The organisation supports quality improvement and compliance with national healthcare standards including NGPA and government incentive programs.

## Key Topics

- General practice accreditation
- RACGP Standards (5th edition)
- AccreditationPro platform
- Aboriginal Medical Services
- Rural and remote health services
- Practice Incentives Program (PIP)
- Workforce Incentive Program (WIP)
- Quality improvement
- AGPAL Group of Companies
- Medical practice standards
- Australian healthcare
- Cultural competency
- Accreditation process
- Corporate group accreditation
- After-hours services

## Core Accreditation Services

- [General practice accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation): General practice accreditation overview against RACGP Standards and NGPA
- [AGPAL accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/agpal-accreditation): AGPAL six-step accreditation process using AccreditationPro platform
- [Non-traditional general practice services accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/non-traditional-gps): Accreditation support for mobile, aged care, and flexible healthcare services
- [Aboriginal Medical Services accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/ams): Streamlined accreditation for Aboriginal Medical Services with cultural support
- [Rural and remote accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/rural-remote): Rural and remote health services accreditation with RFDS and community support
- [Corporate groups accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/corporate-groups): Multi-site corporate group accreditation support and AccreditationPro platform
- [After hours and medical deputising services accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/ahs-mhs): Accreditation for after-hours and medical deputising services against RACGP

## Standards and Compliance

- [RACGP Standards (5th edition)](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/racgp-standards): RACGP Standards 5th edition requirements for general practice accreditation
- [Practice Incentives Program (PIP)](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/pip-practice-incentives-program): PIP payments eligibility for accredited practices, AMS, and ACCHOs
- [Workforce Incentive Program (WIP)](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/wip-workforce-incentive-program): WIP financial incentives for rural and remote healthcare service delivery
- [Peak body and Primary Health Network (PHNs) accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/phns): PHN and ACCHO accreditation support with benchmarking and training services
- [Multi-accreditation](https://www.agpal.com.au/general-practice-accreditation/multi-accreditation): Multi-accreditation against ARVAS, ASES and AGPAL Group standards
